title: PBA: Gómez de Liaño stars in Converge's demolition of Titan Ultra
summary: Juan Gómez de Liaño delivered an efficient triple-double to power Converge's 152-119 rout of Titan Ultra in the PBA Season 50 Governors' Cup, Sunday evening at the Araneta Coliseum.
